props.name: label
props.description: Visible text of the default trigger button. Older callers also pass it next to `children`; there it is ignored, as it always was.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut after the text. A string renders in a Kbd.

props.name: trigger
props.description: `hover` opens on hover and focus after a delay. `click` toggles on press and stays until Escape, an outside click or a second press.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Open delay in ms while the page is cold. Defaults to the provider's (200).

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: Warm window in ms, only used when no TooltipProvider is mounted (300).

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Must accept a ref and props, e.g. a button.

examples.title: Tooltip · danger
examples.code:
<Tooltip
  label="Job number"
  content="Job number is required."
  tone="danger"
/>

examples.title: trigger click
examples.code:
<Tooltip
  trigger="click"
  label="Click me"
  content="Stays open until Escape or an outside click."
/>
